msg: Be as quick as you can when choosing the gnome on either your left or to your right. You will start to notice patterns when each coloured gnome appears. For example, I noticed getting more points for choosing the brown instead of the purple gnome, but I cannot remember whether this is down to it being on the right hand side of the screen or to the left hand side of the screen. Similarly, I noticed getting more mushrooms, or points, if I chose the yellow rather than the reddish-pink gnome, but again, it seemed to depend on what side of the screen the particular coloured gnome would appear. So, for instance, you would start to notice a pattern of getting more points - usually, but not always - for choosing the yellow gnome rather than the pink gnome and vice versa. I could not make out a pattern between the orange gnomes and the green gnomes, but I think that might have been down to chance. Indeed, a lot of the game was the luck of the draw. But as a general rule of thumb, I think the advice of choosing yellow, red and blue often.
